definitions.explanation: Explosive devices that produce colorful lights and sounds for entertainment, popular at summer festivals in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{花火|はなび}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: When summer comes, fireworks festivals are held all over the place.

notes:
{花火|はなび} literally means 'flower fire' because fireworks resemble flowers blooming in the sky.

Types of fireworks:
- ⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ→打ち上げ：noentry⟧{花火|はなび} (aerial fireworks)
- ⟦{手持|てもち}ち→手持ち：07433_temochi⟧{花火|はなび} (handheld fireworks, sparklers)
- ⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：noentry⟧{花火|はなび} (sparklers - thin, delicate type)

Common expressions:
- {花火|はなび}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (fireworks festival)
- {花火|はなび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to set off fireworks)
- {花火|はなび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch fireworks)

Cultural note:
{花火|はなび}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ are major ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ events in Japan, with famous ones including the Sumida River Fireworks in Tokyo and the Lake Biwa Fireworks in Shiga.
